items.name: A log explorer
items.text: Search by keyword, go back up to 14 days and filter by instance, including ones that already crashed.

items.name: A canvas that updates live
items.text: Deploys, scaling and new resources show up within a second. No reload.

items.name: Jump anywhere with ⌘K
items.text: One palette for every project, environment and resource.

items.name: Database metrics and top queries
items.text: CPU, memory, connections and the slowest statements, per database.

items.name: Allowed addresses for public databases
items.text: An exposed database only accepts the ranges you list.

items.name: A global edge in front of every service
items.text: Visitors connect to a location near them, with nothing to change in DNS.
